notes.content: ABOUT THE MAJOR The Pre-Health Sciences - Pre-M.P.T. Emphasis, B.S. prepares students with a broad, interdisciplinary foundation in the sciences, with a focus on preparing students for nursing, medical and dental careers as well as into other allied health career paths such as healthcare administration and clinical lab sciences . Students interested in the Pre-Health Sciences majors should contact the program director as early as possible since specific courses are necessary for adequate preparation for entrance exams such as the Medical College Admission Test (MCAT). This is also true for students interested in medical or dental school opportunities who choose to major in a different discipline. EMPHASIS REQUIREMENT The Pre-M.P.T. Emphasis consists of 20 units in Biology, Chemistry, Kinesiology and Math coursework. See catalog page for details. **Agreement does not include all required courses for the major at FPU** This agreement lists courses that are prerequisites or may be completed prior to transfer to satisfy major requirements. All transfer courses must be completed with a grade of C- or better, and students must complete a minimum of 18 units in the major at FPU. Please contact an academic advisor to discuss the recommended sequence of courses, including courses that may count for both GE and major requirements. To view the full degree requirements, please refer to the Undergraduate Catalog: https://catalog.fresno.edu/index.php .
notes.contentHtml:
ABOUT THE MAJOR

The Pre-Health Sciences - Pre-M.P.T. Emphasis, B.S. prepares students with a broad, interdisciplinary foundation in the sciences, with a focus on preparing students for nursing, medical and dental careers as well as into other allied health career paths such as healthcare administration and clinical lab sciences. Students interested in the Pre-Health Sciences majors should contact the program director as early as possible since specific courses are necessary for adequate preparation for entrance exams such as the Medical College Admission Test (MCAT). This is also true for students interested in medical or dental school opportunities who choose to major in a different discipline.


EMPHASIS REQUIREMENT

The Pre-M.P.T. Emphasis consists of 20 units in Biology, Chemistry, Kinesiology and Math coursework. See catalog page for details.


﻿**Agreement does not include all required courses for the major at FPU**

This agreement lists courses that are prerequisites or may be completed prior to transfer to satisfy major requirements. All transfer courses must be completed with a grade of C- or better, and students must complete a minimum of 18 units in the major at FPU. Please contact an academic advisor to discuss the recommended sequence of courses, including courses that may count for both GE and major requirements. To view the full degree requirements, please refer to the Undergraduate Catalog: https://catalog.fresno.edu/index.php.
